title: The Sue's Our Way Chicken Curry Tenet

source_provenance.ideation_context: Formulated while Rick was making Sue's Our Way Chicken Curry.

core.clean: The universes, in all their CoScendence+, CoBeauty+ and CoGradient+, are not necessarily quantum in themselves and may never have been, at least CoTime+-relationally. What appears CoQuantum+ may arise through the relations by which observers such as we CoCivites encounter reality.
core.scientific_safe: CoTheoryAll+ explores whether quantum structure is fundamental ontology or an observer-relative projection of deeper relational structure.
core.memeographic: Maybe reality isn't quantum. Maybe we are.

background_semantics.warm_core: source-time provenance and lived ideation context

candidate_terms.CoStrawBe+: A deliberately provisional, public, challengeable working projection that may grow, fork or be superseded.
candidate_terms.CoChomp+: Candidate ingestion relation: receive, parse, contextualize, transform, preserve provenance, expose losses and emit receiver-fit projections.
candidate_terms.CoChomp_wordplay: Name may evoke chomping and Noam Chomsky; wordplay only, not endorsement, attribution or claim of theoretical equivalence.
candidate_terms.CoMetaphorCarry+: Candidate relation for how metaphorical distance, absurdity and incongruity may increase salience, recall, compression and cross-domain recombination while also increasing ambiguity, distortion and receiver mismatch.
candidate_terms.CoWeird+: Receiver-relative style/projection relation favoring meaningful strangeness over decorative novelty.
candidate_terms.CoLudicrous+: High-incongruity projection relation used to expose, compress or remix structure without implying literal truth.
candidate_terms.CoPressure+: Candidate receiver-relative pressure relation arising when relational density, metaphorical distance, novelty and projection demands exceed available attention or representational bandwidth.

challenge_path: Relate results to established quantum foundations rather than renaming them.

memeographic_constellation.source: The universes are hot and wet, because, like any container, they would not slide off surfaces if we had to bear the entire weight of them alone, eh?
memeographic_constellation.projection: The universes are hot and wet. Otherwise somebody would have to carry the whole lot.

metaphor_carry.hypothesis: Greater metaphorical distance can sometimes increase semantic transport by increasing salience, memory, compression and generative recombination.
metaphor_carry.counterrelation: Beyond a receiver-relative threshold, additional absurdity can increase ambiguity, distortion, confusion or noise.

satirical_classification.dangerous_to_mental_states_source_joke: Marked in spirit as dangerous to thinkers who may be overconfident about how much any observer/model gets right.
